The '''Griffyn-XTG Lightspeed Unit''' was a Class 1.0 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] engine made by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. It was usually used on SoroSuub vehicles since it did not work well with non-compatible systems.
